purpose: Intercepted-route modal: a /sign-up link on the homepage pins and hides the page column over the still-visible backdrop and hosts the sign-up form; closing restores / and its scroll.
retrievalIneligibleReason: Runtime UI: the modal shell (backdrop, close control, focus trap) that hosts the sign-up form over the homepage; the form itself is the retrievable block.

variants.description: Dialog viewport with the form popup; opens instantly.

contentBudgetNote: x-maxWords = ceil(1.25 x observed max words in the real copy), rounded up to an even number (min 2); x-observedMaxWords is the measured maximum. x-maxChars (legal) = observed maximum characters. Enforced per instance by schema/semantic_validate.py.

motion.reducedMotionEvidence: Generation requirement: reducedMotionFallback is const-locked per section. Where the clone source shows a real prefers-reduced-motion branch it is cited in measuredFrom; otherwise it is a required fallback, not a measured behaviour.

notes: Not a separate route: an overlay state of template.home (see ia.json).
